Messages.Author: jblacey
Messages.Body:
Name: Darla, The Researcher
Capacity: 4
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan:
Discipline:
Camarilla. When Darla enters play, you may search library (shuffle afterwards) for two Master: Discipline cards and put them on ready vampires.

Art notes:

Her hair is tied behind her head. She is wearing robes with a high collar and she is holding 3 tomes in the corner of her left arm. The bottom tome has a bookmark in it. There is a key ring with three keys on it around her left wrist.

World of Darkness Reference:

You can see a picture of her on page 81 of the Tremere Clanbook (Revised Edition), she is the sample character titled: Cloistered Researcher.

How does this card address a compelling game need?:

She is a cheap Camarilla vampire for Tremere though her ability is extremely flexible allowing her to give disciplines to more powerful vampires and she makes discipline combinations easier to accomplish. Worst case scenario she fits into an Auspex and Thamaturgy deck and she can give herself Superior in both as a 4 capacity. Best use of her is to give two different vampires that have basic disciplines an upgrade. She can also give herself Superior Auspex so that she can be a Wall and still have another discipline card left over for another vampire.

Created by:
Justin Lacey

Update: July 7th 2017
Here is text from the last update

Capacity: 4
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan:
Discipline:
Group: 5
Camarilla. You may lock Darla to search your ash heap, hand, or library (shuffle afterwards) for a Master: Discipline card and put it on a ready vampire as a discard phase action.

Update: July 24th 2017
Her ability is was 180 characters, now it is 174 characters. The hand selection isn't super relevant and hopeful it makes it a little easier to fit in the text box. Trimming the ash heap selection would free up 9 more characters, but hopefully that isn't necessary. Her point value is fine, as her ability locks her and it has a narrow use only getting a very specific type of card, it easily fits as 1 point ability.

Messages.Author: jblacey
Messages.Body:
After some thought this seems a like reasonable option:

Name: Darla, The Researcher
Capacity: 4
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan:
Discipline:
Group: 5
Camarilla. You may lock Darla to search your library (shuffle afterwards) for a Master: Discipline card and put it on a ready vampire as a discard phase action.

Reasons:

1) No chance for Soul Gem shenanigans since everything takes phase in the discard phase.
2) The discard phase action is the cost, but it is not an action that can be blocked.
3) It only gets 1 discipline not 2 initially.
4) Since discard phase occurs after the influence phase, she can still use it on her first turn.
5) Discard phase actions are under utilized currently.
6) There is combo potential with other cards like Metro Underground, Powerbase: Los Angeles, William Thorbecke, Unmada, etc.
7) Moved her to Group 5, because Group 3 has multiple aus tha vamps, but group 5 only has one 4 capacity vampire and the rest are 5 capacity or above.

Better?
